definitions.explanation: In a relaxed, composed manner without rushing. Implies having plenty of time or being untroubled.
With a comfortable margin; without difficulty.

examples.japanese: {悠々|ゆうゆう}と{生活|せいかつ}している。
{試験|しけん}に{悠々|ゆうゆう}と{合格|ごうかく}した。
{悠々|ゆうゆう}{自適|じてき}の{老後|ろうご}を{送|おく}る。
examples.english: To live a comfortable retirement doing as one pleases.

notes:
PATTERNS:
・{悠々|ゆうゆう}と + verb (leisurely, calmly)
・{悠々|ゆうゆう}たる + noun (literary, leisurely)
・{悠々|ゆうゆう}{自適|じてき} (living a leisurely, self-indulgent life)

NUANCES:
・When describing actions: unhurried, at ease
・When describing achievements: with room to spare, easily

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・のんびり (leisurely, in a carefree manner)
・ゆったり (relaxed, loose)
・{余裕|よゆう}を{持|も}って (with room to spare)

CULTURAL NOTE: {悠々|ゆうゆう}{自適|じてき} is a common expression for the ideal retirement lifestyle.
